card.name: Adverse reactions and warning phrases
card.fires_on: The comma after "life-threatening" in boxed warnings, and the word "reactions" (or the end of "Reactions" / "Toxicology") after "adverse" in cross-references and dose-modification text.

modes.label: Comma in warning list
modes.description: Comma after "Serious, life-threatening" just before "or fatal respiratory depression".
modes.example: ( 5.1 ) Serious, life-threatening<<,>> or fatal respiratory depression may occur.

modes.label: Adverse reactions
modes.description: The word "reactions" completing "adverse reactions" in dosing or section references.
modes.example: For adverse<< reactions>>, consider interruption of treatment or dose reduction

card.plain: It lights up on the closing word of phrases like "adverse reactions" and on the comma in "serious, life-threatening, or fatal" in drug warnings.
